verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken structure. The SOLSTICE wordmark is enlarged and pushed below the headline, so reading order and hierarchy are wrong. The flavour pills are in reverse order, the legal text is crammed into a tiny three-line block beside the pills, and the CTA pill butts against the text column's left edge. B is slightly worse: its CTA sits about 8px from the left canvas edge and touches the headline, and its whole text block is shifted further left and packed tighter, leaving the right side emptier.
